subject.title: [security] Revoked bridge managers can leave WebVNC and Code backend agents available

question: Should accepted WebVNC and Code backend agents be manage-scoped bridge sessions that carry and revalidate the creating manager's revocable grant after ticket consumption?
rationale: The source evidence shows the current gap, but the repair changes security-boundary fail-closed behavior for live backend infrastructure and should be explicitly accepted by the bridge-auth owner.

options.title: Bind and revalidate backend agents
options.body: Store the consumed ticket's revocable grant on WebVNC and Code agent attachments and close those agents when the grant is no longer current.

options.title: Close backend agents on any relevant revocation
options.body: Use a broader but more disruptive revocation rule that clears lease backend agents when manager/share/token state shrinks and attribution is incomplete.

options.title: Document lease-level backend agents
options.body: Keep backend agents as lease infrastructure after ticket acceptance and document that manager revocation does not close already accepted backend bridges.

recommendation.title: Bind and revalidate backend agents
recommendation.body: Store the consumed ticket's revocable grant on WebVNC and Code agent attachments and close those agents when the grant is no longer current.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the Worker bridge-auth and revocation code paths involved in this decision.
